user_approved_method: Fit the synthetic wait distribution to my targets.
notice: Designer distribution for a demo, not a clinical prediction or validated NHS statistic. Raw queue waits are retained separately.
method: One shared monotone empirical-CDF-to-quantile mapping across all sites; preserves queue-derived ordering and ties. Power-shaped within-band quantiles, exponential tail; tail scale fitted to mean120; fourth-band power fitted to median100. Integer stored estimate is ceil(fitted wait).
capacity_use: Queue rankings already include doctor rosters, beds, urgency, staffing, specialties and recurring/random intake. Hold this fitted mapping fixed when evaluating different raw queue outcomes; automatic refitting would erase changes to the overall distribution.
limitations: Fitted to one synthetic month. Per-site distributions are not independently forced. Raw queue values above the fitted support are rejected so severe overload cannot silently be capped. Does not reproduce treatment-resource event timings. No validated causal or clinical interpretation.
